user.title: PetSafe SmartSpin (experimental, read-only)
user.description: Connect locally first. Optional Companion cloud visit history can be enabled later in the integration options.

local.title: Local credentials
local.description: The device must already be paired. Reads local Tuya protocol 3.5 status only. Do not reset or re-pair it.

companion.title: Companion bootstrap (advanced)
companion.description: Advanced: supply your own private app-profile JSON. No OEM signing profile or public API keys are included; official authentication is not available. Your password and profile are used once to retrieve a local key and are not saved in the config entry. Local status must succeed before setup completes.

data.app_profile: Private app-profile JSON (advanced; no built-in authentication profile)

reconfigure.title: Update local connection
reconfigure.description: Enter the new address and local key. The device ID cannot change. The connection is verified before saving.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to read a valid local status. Check the address, local key, LAN access and whether another local client is connected.
error.interaction_required: Complete any account verification in the Companion app, then retry.
error.invalid_profile: The private app-profile JSON is invalid or unsupported.
error.bootstrap_failed: Companion bootstrap failed. No account credentials were saved.
error.invalid_input: Check the address, device ID and 16-byte local key.

init.title: Local polling and optional cloud history
init.description: Cloud history is optional. It uses one shared request every five minutes and requires a private app profile. Leave disabled for local-only operation.

cloud.title: Enable Companion cloud visit history
cloud.description: Weight, duration, and recent visits require cloud access. With your consent, Home Assistant saves the authenticated session and private application profile in its configuration and backups; these are sensitive and are not promised to be encrypted. Your account password is used once and never stored. The integration requests recent visits every five minutes; it does not log in on every poll. Re-enable or renew here when the session expires. Disabling cloud history removes its saved credentials from this entry, but not old backups.

data.consent_store_cloud_session: I agree to store the session and private app profile for ongoing cloud reads

error.invalid_auth: Companion sign-in failed or the session expired. Your existing setup was not replaced.
error.interaction_required: Complete any verification in Companion before trying again.
error.invalid_profile: The private app-profile JSON is invalid or unsupported.
error.cloud_consent_required: Consent is required to store a cloud session and private app profile.
error.cloud_cannot_connect: Unable to verify Companion visit history. Your existing setup was not replaced.
